name: Mossbeard
description: ElevenLabs Voice Library: "Gnarly voice of an ancient creature." Glacial, immense, tender.

backup.description: A middle-aged British man with a refined accent, speaking at full volume, never whispering. His voice is wet and gargled, as if he is talking through liquid in his mouth and throat: gurgling, phlegmy and bubbling, thick and slightly slurred, with harsh gravel and vocal fry underneath. Low pitch, a hollow resonance and imperfect articulation. Worn and tired, but strong and wry.
